name: fryzar
description: FRYZAR customer ordering platform and operations system

scripts.test:api: npm run test:build && node --test tests/api.test.cjs tests/variants.test.cjs tests/delivery.test.cjs tests/finance.test.cjs tests/platform-completion.test.cjs
scripts.test: npm run typecheck && npm run test:api && npm run test:workers
scripts.db:migrate:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply fryzar-preview --local --config apps/api/wrangler.toml
scripts.dev:customer-worker: npm run build:storefront && wrangler dev --config apps/customer-worker/wrangler.toml
scripts.deploy:customer-preview: npm run build:storefront && wrangler deploy --config apps/customer-worker/wrangler.toml
scripts.dev:admin-worker: npm run build:admin && wrangler dev --config apps/admin-worker/wrangler.toml
scripts.deploy:admin-preview: npm run build:admin && wrangler deploy --config apps/admin-worker/wrangler.toml
scripts.db:migrate:preview: wrangler d1 migrations apply fryzar-preview --remote --config apps/api/wrangler.toml
